chapter.title: Apotheosis
chapter.subtitle: Start with the Salvaging Table and follow the chain

quests.title: Salvaging Table
quests.subtitle: Break down affix items
description: Affix items are gear with random rarity (Common to Mythic) and bonuses. A Salvaging Table breaks them down into rarity materials and Gem Dust.
Next: collect some Gem Dust from salvaging.

quests.title: Gem Dust
quests.subtitle: Salvaged gem material
description: Gem Dust drops when you salvage gems and affix items. It is the currency of gem upgrading.
Next: a Gem Cutting Table to spend it.

quests.title: Gem Cutting Table
quests.subtitle: Upgrade your gems
description: A Gem Cutting Table uses Gem Dust and rarity materials to upgrade gems from Cracked up to Flawless.
Next: a Simple Reforging Table to reroll affixes.

quests.title: Simple Reforging Table
quests.subtitle: Reroll affixes
description: A Simple Reforging Table rerolls the affixes on an item, giving you another chance at good rolls.
Next: a Sigil of Socketing to add gem sockets.

quests.title: Sigil of Socketing
quests.subtitle: Add gem sockets
description: A Sigil of Socketing adds a socket to an item so you can slot a gem into it.
Next: a Reforging Table for advanced reforging.

quests.title: Reforging Table
quests.subtitle: Advanced reforging
description: A Reforging Table rerolls affixes with higher rarity materials for better results.
Next: an Augmenting Table to boost individual affixes.

quests.title: Augmenting Table
quests.subtitle: Boost individual affixes
description: An Augmenting Table uses Sigils of Enhancement to overcharge individual affixes on your gear.
Next: move a spawner with Silk Touch.

quests.title: Silk Touch Spawner
quests.subtitle: Move a mob spawner
description: Mine a mob spawner with a Silk Touch pickaxe to move it. Apotheosis lets you modify moved spawners.
Next: a Spawner Rune to modify its behavior.

quests.title: Spawner Rune
quests.subtitle: Modify your spawner
description: Spawner Runes change how a moved spawner behaves - faster, quieter, no AI, or no light requirements.
This completes the Apotheosis chapter.

quests.title: Gem Case
quests.subtitle: Store your gems
description: A Gem Case stores and displays your gem collection.

quests.title: Sigil of Enhancement
quests.subtitle: Fuel the augmenting table
description: A Sigil of Enhancement fuels the Augmenting Table to overcharge affixes.

quests.title: Spawner Chain
quests.subtitle: From spawner explosions
description: A Spawner Chain drops when a mob spawner is detonated with an explosive.
